steps.name: Enter demo app
steps.goal: If the data and AI providers consent screen is shown, tap Agree and continue for this demo test account. Otherwise wait for Home.
steps.done: The app navigation button is visible.

steps.name: Open audio settings
steps.goal: Tap Navigation. Computer: Your Computer, then tap Settings.
steps.done: The production Settings screen includes the three transcription modes and language.

steps.name: Select Auto mode
steps.goal: Tap the Auto transcription mode button with id transcription-auto. Keep the language unchanged.
steps.done: The Auto mode button is selected.

steps.name: Native model ready
steps.goal: Wait for the native on-device model to become ready. Do not change the controls.
steps.done: Whistle has downloaded and loaded in the actual iOS app.

steps.name: Local override
steps.done: Local transcription uses the loaded native model.

steps.name: Unsupported language
steps.done: Settings explains that Cantonese requires cloud.

steps.name: Restore language
steps.goal: Tap Language and choose Auto detect.
steps.done: The language is Auto detect and the native model is ready.

steps.name: Restore Auto mode
steps.goal: Tap the Auto transcription mode button with id transcription-auto. Keep the language unchanged.
steps.done: The Auto mode button is selected with the model ready.
